text:
Anthony Cirelli missed the Lightning's game against Columbus on Nov. 12 with an injury, along with Erik Cernak and Yanni Gourde, according to Daily Faceoff and others. The timing stings, because Cirelli had 11 points in his last ten games, including three assists in the Nov. 11 rout in Buffalo.

His box score has undersold him all season. Tampa has had 61% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, nearly seven points better than when he sits, and yet the Lightning have scored 7.3 fewer goals than those chances deserved while he's out there. That gap usually closes, and when it does, his assists follow. His own finishing, 17.2%, is running a bit high.

Evolving-Hockey had him driving play in the 95th percentile last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 20% of his setups crossing the royal road, nearly three times the typical forward. Watch how long he's out and who takes his defensive matchups.
headline: Cirelli is out, and Tampa will miss more than points
